fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local commentary on Miami’s economic strain and banking credit, city commission politics and appointments, and a dispute over hiring outside bands versus supporting local union musicians for park entertainment. Reports and opinion address a fatal shooting involving federal customs officers and alleged rum-runners near Biscayne Bay/Haulover, a fire in the Black neighborhood exacerbated by a cut-off water main, and Miami Beach’s ordinance restricting jitneys and private buses in favor of a railway company franchise. Additional columns cover civic controversies, local business notes and advertisements, and sports promotion including a boxing match and bicycle races.
